patterns.name: POJO / JavaBean to Data Class
patterns.javaPattern: public class User { private String id; public String getId() { return id; } public void setId(String id) { this.id = id; } }
patterns.kotlinPattern: data class User(var id: String? = null)
patterns.description: Replaces verbose Java POJOs containing getters, setters, equals, hashCode, and toString with concise Kotlin data classes.

patterns.name: Null Check to Safe Call & Elvis Operator
patterns.javaPattern: if (user != null && user.getName() != null) { return user.getName(); } else { return "default"; }
patterns.description: Converts conditional null checks and defensive guards into idiomatic Kotlin safe calls (?.) and Elvis operator (?:).

patterns.name: Static Utility Class to Object / Top-Level Function
patterns.javaPattern: public class StringUtils { public static boolean isEmpty(String s) { return s == null || s.trim().isEmpty(); } }
patterns.description: Transforms Java static utility classes into Kotlin objects or top-level extension functions.

patterns.name: StringBuilder to String Templates
patterns.javaPattern: new StringBuilder().append("Hello ").append(name).append("!").toString()
patterns.description: Replaces imperative StringBuilder concatenations with Kotlin string interpolation templates.

patterns.name: Imperative Loop to Collection Operations
patterns.javaPattern: List<User> adults = new ArrayList<>(); for (User u : users) { if (u.getAge() >= 18) { adults.add(u); } }
patterns.description: Replaces Java for-each filtering/mapping loops with functional Kotlin collection operations like filter, map, and find.

patterns.name: Anonymous Inner Class to SAM Lambda
patterns.javaPattern: button.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() { @Override public void onClick(View v) { doSomething(); } });
patterns.description: Converts single-method anonymous inner classes and listeners into concise trailing Kotlin lambdas.

patterns.name: AsyncTask / Thread Execution to Kotlin Coroutines
patterns.javaPattern: new AsyncTask<Void, Void, String>() { protected String doInBackground(Void... p) { return fetchData(); } }.execute();
patterns.description: Replaces legacy Android AsyncTask or background threads with structured Kotlin Coroutines and suspend functions.

patterns.name: Callback Interface to Suspending Function
patterns.javaPattern: public interface DataCallback { void onSuccess(Data data); void onError(Exception e); }
patterns.description: Transforms asynchronous callback listeners into direct sequential suspending functions.

patterns.name: Android XML Layout to Jetpack Compose UI
patterns.javaPattern: <LinearLayout><TextView android:text="Title"/><Button android:text="Submit"/></LinearLayout>
patterns.kotlinPattern: @Composable fun Screen() { Column { Text("Title"); Button(onClick = {}) { Text("Submit") } } }
patterns.description: Migrates imperative Android XML layout definitions to declarative Jetpack Compose composable components.

patterns.name: Try-With-Resources to .use Extension
patterns.javaPattern: try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file))) { return br.readLine(); }
patterns.description: Replaces Java 7 try-with-resources blocks with Kotlin's auto-closing .use {} extension.

patterns.name: Singleton Boilerplate to Object Declaration
patterns.javaPattern: public class Manager { private static Manager instance; public static synchronized Manager getInstance() { ... } }
patterns.description: Replaces double-checked locking singleton boilerplate with Kotlin first-class object declarations.

patterns.name: Switch Statement to When Expression
patterns.javaPattern: switch (status) { case SUCCESS: return 1; case ERROR: return 0; default: return -1; }
patterns.description: Converts Java switch statements into exhaustive, expression-based Kotlin when constructs.

patterns.name: Java Optional to Kotlin Nullable Type
patterns.javaPattern: Optional<User> userOpt = Optional.ofNullable(user); String name = userOpt.map(User::getName).orElse("unknown");
patterns.description: Replaces Java 8 Optional wrappers with native Kotlin nullable types (T?).

patterns.name: Getter/Setter Invocations to Property Access
patterns.javaPattern: user.setUsername("Alice"); String name = user.getUsername();
patterns.description: Replaces getX() and setX() method calls with idiomatic Kotlin synthetic property access syntax.

patterns.name: Constant Interface to Object Const Val
patterns.javaPattern: public interface Constants { public static final String API_URL = "https://api.com"; }
patterns.description: Replaces anti-pattern constant interfaces with Kotlin top-level constants or companion object const val.

patterns.name: Thread.sleep to Coroutine delay
patterns.javaPattern: Thread.sleep(1000);
patterns.description: Replaces blocking Thread.sleep calls inside asynchronous scopes with non-blocking coroutine delay().

patterns.name: Explicit ArrayList Instantiation to mutableListOf()
patterns.javaPattern: List<String> items = new ArrayList<>(); items.add("a");
patterns.description: Replaces raw Java collection instantiations with Kotlin stdlib collection factory functions like mutableListOf().

patterns.name: System.out.println to Kotlin println
patterns.javaPattern: System.out.println("Message: " + msg);
patterns.description: Replaces verbose System.out.println console logging with Kotlin stdlib top-level println.

patterns.name: Callback Interface / Async Listener to Suspending Function
patterns.javaPattern:
public interface DataCallback<T> { void onSuccess(T result); void onError(Exception e); }
public void loadUserData(String userId, DataCallback<User> callback) { ... }
patterns.kotlinPattern: suspend fun loadUserData(userId: String): User = suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation -> ... }
patterns.description: Transforms asynchronous callback listeners (onSuccess/onError) and Runnable thread patterns into clean Kotlin suspend functions or Flows.

patterns.name: Explicit Generic Type Parameter for findViewById
patterns.javaPattern: EditText etItem = (EditText) findViewById(R.id.etItem);
patterns.description: findViewById requires explicit generic type in Kotlin: findViewById<EditText>(R.id.foo), never bare findViewById(R.id.foo) assigned to a typed variable.

patterns.name: Preserve and Add Explicit Stdlib Imports
patterns.javaPattern:
File file = new File(getFilesDir(), "todo.txt");
Set<String> set = new HashSet<>();
patterns.kotlinPattern:
import java.io.File
import java.util.HashSet

val file = File(filesDir, "todo.txt")
val set: MutableSet<String> = HashSet()
patterns.description: Explicit imports for common Java stdlib classes (java.io.File, java.util.HashSet, etc.) must be preserved/added even when not present in original Java import list if used in translated logic.

patterns.name: SharedPreferences getStringSet Type Handling
patterns.javaPattern: HashSet<String> items = (HashSet<String>) prefs.getStringSet("items", new HashSet<String>());
patterns.kotlinPattern:
val set: Set<String>? = prefs.getStringSet("items", null)
val items: HashSet<String> = if (set != null) HashSet(set) else HashSet()
patterns.description: SharedPreferences.getStringSet() returns MutableSet<String>, not HashSet<String> — wrap explicitly with HashSet(...) if the original Java code specifically typed it as HashSet.

patterns.name: Support Library vs AndroidX Dependency Alignment
patterns.javaPattern: import android.support.v7.app.AppCompatActivity; // or androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
patterns.description: Support library vs AndroidX: check the target project's actual build.gradle dependency (com.android.support vs androidx) before choosing which AppCompatActivity import to use — never emit both.

patterns.name: Activity Views and State as Class Properties
patterns.description: Declare Activity View references as class-level lateinit var or properties instead of local val inside onCreate so sibling methods (onSave, onCancel, populateEditText) can access them without nesting methods inside onCreate.

patterns.name: File Reading & Writing with Kotlin Stdlib Extensions
patterns.description: Use Kotlin stdlib File extensions (file.readLines(), file.writeText()) to read and write text files cleanly without hallucinating static methods on SQLiteOpenHelper or requiring external Commons-IO libraries.

patterns.name: SQLite OpenHelper Cursor Query and Column Extraction
patterns.description: Ensure SQLite database queries match their declared return types (ArrayList<String> vs List<Task>) and use cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow safely inside do-while loops.

patterns.name: Activity Options Menu Inflation and Item Selection
patterns.description: Implement Activity options menus with menuInflater.inflate using the authentic R.menu resource and handle item selection with when (item.itemId) expressions.

patterns.name: Preserve Empty / Blank Return Semantics
patterns.description: A Java early-return guard such as `if (s.isEmpty()) return s;` returns the EMPTY STRING, not null. Do not convert it into a nullable return that yields null, and do not treat a blank string as empty. The return type stays non-null, and a blank input like '   ' is NOT empty, so it flows through the normal transformation path and comes back unchanged.

patterns.name: Preserve Java NullPointerException on Unchecked Parameters
patterns.description: When Java dereferences a parameter with no null check, passing null throws NullPointerException - that IS the characterized behaviour. Keep the Kotlin parameter non-nullable so the same exception escapes at the same point. Adding `?.`, `isNullOrEmpty()`, or `?: return null` makes the migrated code return a value where the original threw, which is a behavioural regression even though it looks safer.

patterns.name: SQLiteOpenHelper Context Constructor
patterns.description: Keep the single Context-taking constructor exactly as-is. Do NOT add a zero-argument constructor or default the Context parameter - the constructor signature is part of the characterized surface, and adding a no-arg overload changes how the class is instantiated reflectively. Database name and version become `const val` inside a companion object.

patterns.name: Android Framework Calls Stay Framework Calls
patterns.description: Under the android.jar stub classpath every framework call throws RuntimeException("Stub!"), and the verifier treats a stub on BOTH sides as equivalent. Keep delegating to super and keep the framework call in place. Do not replace it with a hand-written substitute or a hardcoded return value to make a test pass - that removes the stub and breaks the equivalence. Match the overridden signature exactly (e.g. `item: MenuItem`, not `item: MenuItem?`) or the override will not compile.
